text:
ITEM 1 | Sliced green squash/zucchini-like pieces, pale green skin with lighter flesh, thin half-moon and wedge cuts about 4-6 cm long and 1 cm thick, some with slight browning and a glossy, moist sheen, arranged in a loose pile on the left of the plate, with a few yellowish-cream edged pieces mixed in | 110
ITEM 2 | Flat bread pieces with golden-brown crust edges, topped with melted pale cheese and reddish-brown sauce spots, scorched patches on top, about 2 slices covering roughly one-fifth of the plate in an overlapping arrangement on the upper right, each slice about 10 cm long and 1 cm thick with a soft, slightly chewy look | 150
ITEM 3 | Cubes of golden-brown, crisp-looking roasted potato-like pieces with darker seasoned flecks and herb bits, about 2-3 cm across, firm and dry-looking, with some browned, slightly oily surfaces, scattered in the middle of the plate next to the vegetables | 105
ITEM 4 | Creamy white spread or dip, soft and slightly textured with small flecks, mounded in a cluster about 5 cm across on the right side of the plate, matte to slightly glossy, holding its shape, with a smooth semi-firm consistency | 60
